about: One-variable changes, tried in this order. Each value is tried on its own against the current base; an accepted value becomes the new base before the next trial.

skipped.unsure_band_cfc_head: the unsure-only CfC head was scored as a whole (eda/out/improve_neuro.csv) but its per-row out-of-fold probabilities were not saved, so it cannot be added as a one-variable change here

refine: after the queue: for every numeric knob whose value was accepted in this round, try the two neighbours (halfway to the next tried value on each side)
rounds: a round that accepted at least one change is followed by another round over the whole queue against the new base (max 4 rounds), until a round accepts nothing or the 60-minute budget runs out
